text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe's debut race had come to
an 
end. Her "friend" still seemed impossibly 
far ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still don't know how to catch up to
her. All I can do is push forward together
with Manhattan Cafe,
deepening my understanding 
of her along the way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to close the massive gap between 
herself and her "friend," she decided to 
steadily build up her experience through 
training and races first.
